title: Cross-frequency ear discordance does not establish improved hearing-difficulty prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: Cross-frequency cancellation of interaural threshold differences did not establish incremental hearing-difficulty prediction: NHANES source n=3816, target n=4263; weighted target Brier gain 0.00007921 (95% joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap interval -0.00084800 to 0.00047652). Independently sampled2011–2012 and2015–2016 cross-sections were used for frozen-model transfer, not splits of one dataset. The interval permits benefit and harm, not equivalence. AI-authored, author-self-checked, not independently peer reviewed.
